import re,glob,os,datetime as dt,collections,sys
TXT='/tmp/r2run-6uka239f/data/text'
def odate(fn):
    s=os.path.basename(fn)[:-4]
    m=re.search(r'(\d{2})[.]?(\d{2})[.]?(\d{2})$',s)
    mm,dd,yy=map(int,m.groups()); return dt.date(2000+yy,mm,dd)
DRE=re.compile(r'(\d{1,2})\s*/\s*(\d{1,2})\s*/\s*(\d{4})')
rows=[]; issues=[]
for fn in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(TXT,'*.txt'))):
    t=open(fn,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    od=odate(fn)
    pages=re.split(r'=== page \d+',t)[1:]
    for pi,p in enumerate(pages,2):
        if re.search(r'IN THE MATTER|ORDER OF THE COMMISSION',p): continue
        if not re.search(r'Recommendation|Case\s*Number|Respondent',p): continue
        q=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',p)
        m=re.search(r'Date\s*of\s*Damage:[ \t]*(\d{1,2}\s*/\s*\d{1,2}\s*/\s*\d{4})',q)
        dmg=None
        if m:
            dmg=DRE.search(m.group(1))
        else:
            # layout where labels precede values: advisory date first, damage second
            ds=[x for x in DRE.finditer(q)]
            adv=re.search(r'Date\s*of\s*Advisory\s*Meeting:[ \t]*(\d{1,2}\s*/\s*\d{1,2}\s*/\s*\d{4})',q)
            if len(ds)>=2:
                dmg=ds[1]
                issues.append((os.path.basename(fn),pi,'dmg-inferred-from-2nd-date'))
            else:
                issues.append((os.path.basename(fn),pi,'no-damage-date'))
        cn=re.search(r'Case\s*Number:[ \t]*(\d+)',q)
        rec=dict(file=os.path.basename(fn),page=pi,case=cn.group(1) if cn else None,order=od,damage=None)
        if dmg:
            try:
                rec['damage']=dt.date(int(dmg.group(3)),int(dmg.group(1)),int(dmg.group(2)))
            except ValueError:
                issues.append((os.path.basename(fn),pi,'bad-date '+dmg.group(0)))
        rows.append(rec)
EOF

for i in issues[:60]: print(i)
EOF
